ja: うちが先週会議室を押さえてたら、今ごろ慌ててないのに。
en: If we'd booked the room last week, we wouldn't be scrambling.
alternatives: If we had reserved the room last week, we wouldn't be scrambling.
Had we booked the room last week, we wouldn't be scrambling now.
point: 過去の仮定でも、今の結果は wouldn't be 〜ing

ja: 締め切りは先月三回変わったが、今月はまだだ。
en: The deadline changed three times last month, but hasn't since.
alternatives: The deadline was moved three times last month; nothing since.
The deadline shifted three times last month, but hasn't since.
point: 先月は過去形、その後の「まだ」は現在完了の hasn't

ja: あと1週間あれば、もっとテストできるのに。
en: If we had another week, we could test more.
alternatives: With another week, we could test more.
Given one more week, we could test more.
point: 現実と違う仮定なので had と could の過去形を使う

ja: 締め切り、部長に延ばしてもらえる？
en: Can you get the manager to extend it?
alternatives: Can you ask the manager to extend it?
Could you ask the manager for an extension?
point: get 人 to 動詞 の to を落とさない

ja: 月曜から、ずっと日程を決めようとしてるんです。
en: I've been trying to set a date since Monday.
alternatives: I've been trying to pick a date since Monday.
I've been trying to find a date since Monday.
point: 「ずっと〜しようとしている」は I've been trying to で表す

ja: 先方は水曜なら出られると言っていました。
en: The client said they could do Wednesday.
alternatives: The client said Wednesday would work for them.
The client told us they could make Wednesday.
point: 時制の一致で can は could にする

ja: 会議の変更、もっと早く教えてほしかった。
en: I wish you'd told me about it sooner.
alternatives: If only you'd told me earlier.
I wish you'd let me know sooner.
point: 過去への後悔は I wish + had 過去分詞

ja: 先方にずらすよう頼んでもらえますか？
en: Could you ask the client to reschedule?
alternatives: Can you ask the client to reschedule?
Could you ask them to reschedule?
point: ask＋人＋to do の形。人のあとに to 不定詞を続ける

ja: 次の打ち合わせはいつですか？
en: When is our next meeting?
alternatives: When's the next meeting?
When do we meet next?
point: When の後は is + 主語の順。be 動詞を忘れない

ja: 来週の火曜日のほうが都合がいいです。
en: Next Tuesday is better for me.
alternatives: Next Tuesday works better for me.
Tuesday next week is better for me.
point: 「都合がいい」は better for me で比較級にする

ja: 全員が出られる日はありますか？
en: Is there a day everyone can make?
alternatives: Is there a day when everyone's free?
Is there any day everyone can come?
point: 「出られる日」は a day の後ろに everyone can make を続ける

ja: 会議を月曜日に移しましょう。
en: Let's move the meeting to Monday.
alternatives: Let's change the meeting to Monday.
Let's reschedule the meeting for Monday.
point: 曜日の前は on だが「〜に移す」は move to

ja: 彼女は延長を頼んだだけでなく、会議もずらした。
en: Not only did she request an extension, she moved the meeting.
alternatives: She not only requested an extension but moved the meeting.
Not only did she ask for time, she moved the meeting.
point: Not only の後は did she seek と疑問文の語順

ja: 電話した時、彼らはもう日程を変えていた。
en: When I called, they'd already changed the date.
alternatives: They'd already changed the date when I called.
They had already rescheduled when I called.
point: 電話より前の出来事なので had changed

ja: 早く知っていたら、予定を変えられたのに。
en: If I'd known sooner, I could've changed plans.
alternatives: Had I known earlier, I could've changed my plans.
If I'd known earlier, I could have rescheduled.
point: 過去の仮定は had 過去分詞と could have 過去分詞

ja: 締め切りは今週の金曜日です。
en: The deadline is this Friday.
alternatives: The deadline is Friday this week.
It's due this Friday.
point: this Friday の前に on は付けない

ja: 明日、納期を確認するため電話します。
en: We'll call tomorrow to confirm delivery.
alternatives: I'll call tomorrow to check delivery.
We're calling tomorrow to confirm delivery.
point: 「〜するために」は to 不定詞で表す

ja: 火曜の会議は木曜に変更されました。
en: Tuesday's meeting has been moved to Thursday.
alternatives: Tuesday's meeting has been pushed to Thursday.
Tuesday's meeting was rescheduled for Thursday.
point: 変更済みの結果は has been moved の受け身で言う

ja: 会議は、先方が空いている水曜にずらそう。
en: Let's move the meeting to Wednesday, when they're free.
alternatives: Let's shift the meeting to Wednesday, when they're available.
Let's reschedule for Wednesday, when they're free.
point: 曜日の補足は , when ～ で後ろから足す

ja: 私たち、今日中に日程を決めないと。
en: We have to set a date today.
alternatives: We need to pick a date today.
We've got to pick a date today.
point: 「〜しなければならない」は have to で表す

ja: 部長がいつ空いてるか知ってる？
en: Do you know when the manager's free?
alternatives: Do you know when the manager is available?
Any idea when the manager's free?
point: 間接疑問は when the manager is の語順。is を前に出さない

ja: 部長は週末の出勤を避けたがってる。
en: The manager wants to avoid working weekends.
alternatives: The manager doesn't want to work weekends.
The manager wants to avoid weekend work.
point: avoid の後は to 不定詞ではなく -ing

ja: 延長するか、先方から連絡は来た？
en: Has the client said if they'll extend?
alternatives: Have you heard whether the client will extend?
Did the client tell us if they'll extend?
point: 「〜かどうか」は if / whether。語順は平叙文のまま

ja: ずらすべきなのは、デザインではなくテストの工程です。
en: It's the testing phase, not design, that needs rescheduling.
alternatives: It's not design but the testing phase that needs moving.
What needs rescheduling is the testing phase, not design.
point: 強調は It's A, not B, that ～ の語順で

ja: 部長が会議を延ばして、時間を稼いでくれた。
en: The manager postponed the meeting, buying us some time.
alternatives: The manager pushed the meeting back, which bought us time.
The manager delayed the meeting, giving us extra time.
point: 結果を続けて言うときは , buying のように分詞でつなぐ

ja: 頼まれても、リリースはこれ以上前倒しできません。
en: Even if asked, we can't move the release up further.
alternatives: Even if they ask, we can't move the release up.
We can't move the release up further, even if asked.
point: 「前倒し」は move up、Even if asked のように if 節は主語と be を省ける

ja: 私、会議をずらそうかと考え中です。
en: I'm thinking of moving the meeting.
alternatives: I'm considering moving the meeting.
I'm thinking about moving the meeting.
point: of や about の後ろは moving と ing 形にする

ja: 彼は締切を来週月曜に延ばした。
en: He moved the deadline to next Monday.
alternatives: He pushed the deadline to next Monday.
He extended the deadline to next Monday.
point: 「来週の月曜日」は next Monday、前置詞 on は不要

ja: 彼女は締め切りの変更を知らなかったに違いない。
en: She must not have known about the deadline change.
alternatives: She can't have known the deadline was changed.
She must have been unaware of the deadline change.
point: 過去の確信ある推量は must not have + 過去分詞

ja: 打ち合わせを、木曜にずらせないでしょうか。
en: I was wondering if we could reschedule for Thursday.
alternatives: Would it be possible to move the meeting to Thursday?
Could we possibly move the meeting to Thursday?
point: was wondering + if 節にすると依頼が柔らかくなる

ja: みんな忙しいから、会議は延期しよう。
en: Everyone's busy, so let's put the meeting off.
alternatives: Everyone's tied up, so let's postpone the meeting.
Since everyone's busy, let's push the meeting back.
point: 延期は put off / push back。代名詞なら put it off
